strategy.numerical_probe: Call `skimage.draw.ellipsoid_stats(10, 10, 10)` as part of the test suite; buggy behavior is division-by-zero exception, fixed behavior is successful computation matching sphere analytic expressions.

This strategy relies on the fixed test being present (i.e., the PR-added assertions for the sphere case). If you run only the pre-PR test without the equal-semi-axes assertions, the buggy revision may not fail (because the added degeneracy case is what enforces the failure).
